about: Behaviour the owner approved changing in the new system (CLAUDE.md rule 5, docs/NOTES.md). 'replaced': for TARGET=new the scenario is replaced by the one in 'by', which checks the new behaviour with explicit expectations and the unchanged steps against the replaced scenario's goldens. 'added': new behaviour that the legacy app does not have. Both run only for TARGET=new. Nothing else may be skipped.

added.why: Stays signed in when the page is opened again; the test copy signed everyone out.
Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes.
Two browsers save the same record: the second is refused with the approved message and reloads the latest data.
An employee calling the storage API directly cannot change the shop's account, its own permissions, other people's passwords or wipe the data; a shop's page keeps the shop's package.
A branch account calling the storage API directly cannot reach other branches' or HQ's data, other accounts, other branches' requests or the chain's settings; a staff account cannot issue accounts.
Two browsers number a quotation at the same time: the one saved second is saved too, with the next number everywhere that save wrote it, and the message says which number it got; nobody reloads.
A franchise branch's documents are numbered with the chain's branch code (B001-QT261000001) instead of MA, so two branches never issue the same number; numbers given before stay.

Wiping the data needs the shop's exact name; cancelling changes nothing; the copy kept before the wipe is listed with the backup points, restores the data, and cannot be removed through the API; the audit log records the wipe and the restore.

In a VAT-registered shop, leaving VAT off a sale takes the right เลือกไม่คิด VAT (ต้องใส่เหตุผล) and a reason; the document keeps the reason and the audit log records it; an account without that right is refused and the rate stays; after the owner ticks the right and saves the staff form, the person's login still works (the legacy app dropped it).

The VAT of a document is rounded once to the satang on the document's total, halves going up (7% of 1,234.50 is 86.42, not 86.415 shown as 86.41), the total is the base plus that VAT, and the sales tax report lists the same amounts.

The owner closes a month's VAT in the tax report: documents with VAT dated in it can no longer be cancelled or recorded, money is still received, a full tax invoice can still be issued for a sale of that month after a warning (the month's report keeps the number it was filed under and notes the late invoice), and the owner opens the month again with a reason; closing and opening are audited.

The owner issues credit notes: goods returned from a paid sale go back into stock at the lot's cost and are paid back in cash; a price cut on an unpaid sale lowers what is owed. Each takes effect at once, prints with the original invoice, right value, difference, VAT and reason, lowers the sales tax of its own month while the sale's tax invoice stays as issued, and the sale can no longer be cancelled.

A staff member with the right ออกใบลดหนี้ issues a credit note: it waits for approval and changes nothing; the owner approves it from the pending approvals and only then does it lower what the customer owes.

A vendor payment withholds 1% (transport) on the goods receipt's base before VAT: what is withheld lowers what is paid and settles the bill, the payment voucher prints the withholding, and the payment history shows the withholding and the voucher.

ภ.ง.ด.3 / 53 in the tax report count what was withheld by the day it was paid (paid expenses and vendor payments, not expenses still owed), each row with its form and ลำดับที่ and each form summed; the 50 ทวิ certificate follows the Revenue Department's form (copies 1 and 2, the payee's tax id and address, ลำดับที่, the income type, (1) หัก ณ ที่จ่าย), is issued only once paid, and keeps its number when the expense is saved again.

Selling more than is in stock takes the owner or a staff member with an approval right; others are refused and nothing is saved. The provisional cost is corrected when goods arrive and the register cost is the average of what is left.

A stock count's shortage and surplus and an internal issue reach the profit-and-loss at FIFO cost, read from the documents; a shortage can be sold to whoever is responsible without cutting stock twice; the move report shows what leaves as minus with its FIFO unit cost.
An item a franchise branch receives from the central warehouse for the first time asks its unit cost, which becomes its register cost, FIFO lot and stock move cost.

The server refuses saves the screens would not allow for money, tax, people and settings and the rules of tasks 3.3–3.8 (closing a tax month, VAT left off, credit notes, payroll, expenses, cancelling a sale, an employee record, the organisation settings); nothing changes.
The slip picture of a vendor payment is kept by the server as a file and DB.paySlips holds its link instead of the picture.

The slip of a customer payment and the picture of a 50 ทวิ certificate received later are kept by the server as files; DB.paySlips and DB.whtDocs hold their links, and the certificate opens from its link.
A knowledge-library file over 5 MB or a clip over 15 MB is refused with a message to make it smaller, where the legacy app kept only its name; the server refuses it too.
Menu 10 shows the file space used out of 2 GB; once it is used up a product picture is refused when picked, while payment slips are still accepted.
A deleted file is kept 30 days and staff restore it with the server tool; the picture is back on the product with its link.
Importing a legacy backup file with pictures inside uploads them as files and keeps their links in the data (the logo stays inside); exporting again gives links.
A franchise branch's files open for that branch and HQ only, not for another branch's account.

Printing a document or a report names the PDF the browser saves: <type>_<number>_<party>.pdf (walk-in customer "ลูกค้าทั่วไป", "_ยกเลิก" when cancelled) or <title>_<period>.pdf; the page's title carries the name while printing and comes back afterwards. The legacy app leaves the page's title as the PDF name.

The PDF names of a payment voucher (the payee, cleaned of characters a file name may not hold and cut to 80 characters at a word's end), a credit note, one employee's pay slip (the period in place of a number), every employee's pay slips ("ทุกคน") and a warning letter printed before it is saved ("ร่าง").

A quantity typed in the central warehouse's table stays (and keeps the cursor) when the table is reloaded every 7 seconds; asking for stock writes an audit line; a new item received from the central warehouse gets the chain catalogue's category.

When the chain cannot be reached at payment the shop's receipt is recorded first and "ยังไม่ได้แจ้งเครือ ลองใหม่" is shown; pressing "รับชำระ" again only tells the chain, with no second payment or receipt.

A sale paid in the shop before the chain hears of it: billing sends the whole amount and paying puts the chain's number on the existing receipt; cancelling that receipt requires a reason and warns that the chain's paid status and Coins stay.
Taking a chain booking needs the right to create a quotation; billing and taking money through the chain need "บันทึกรับชำระจากลูกหนี้"; nothing reaches the chain or changes in the shop otherwise.
Someone who may not see costs sees "-" for the chain catalogue's cost and the cost of the central warehouse requests.

An asset bought on credit is owed until paid in ชำระเงินเจ้าหนี้ (with withholding, a payment voucher and ภ.ง.ด.53); its VAT is worked out once per tax invoice and is in the input tax report with the vendor's tax ID, the home page and the trial balance (1050, 2010).

The monthly profit and loss spreads depreciation by the days of each month; a disposal needs its date and stops depreciation there; only a purchase on credit with nothing paid can be deleted, others are cancelled with a reason together with a payment made when saved.
An asset with VAT in a closed tax month can still be paid and have its life, salvage and status changed; its tax fields cannot change and it cannot be cancelled.
The financial statements, the trial balance (printed and exported) and the health page (printed) carry depreciation by the day, the cash actually paid for assets and their input VAT in 1050.
A trial staff opened 60 days long warns from 30 days before its last day with the legacy line, banner and tag, from the server's licence; the shop still saves.
After the licence's last day the shop is read-only: the owner opens every menu, opens and prints a document, exports, never refused; a change is refused with the new message and the page reloads.
Staff closing a shop applies to open pages at their next save; employees still sign in and view; suspending an employee's account is still allowed, turning it on is not.
A franchise chain has one licence: HQ and a branch head both see it expired, sign in and view, and are refused changes.
Staff renew with tools/shop-admin.mjs: after a lapse the year counts from the payment day; the shop saves again at once.
Direct API calls of an expired shop: reads, viewing's audit entries and backup points pass; every other change is refused with { error: 'expired' }.
